title: Nach dem Go-live: zwei Folgen zur Freigabe
subtitle: Empfehlung des zweiten Agenten (sechs Punkte) und die vier Kandidaten für Folge 1 und Folge 2, Bild und Text, nichts veröffentlicht

## 1. The six recommendations

| # | Recommendation of the second agent | My position |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | F1 to F5: no further changes; validate F4 on the first real exports, report matched and unmatched | Agreed. Needs the two export files in Downloads. |
| 2 | E1: two episodes as exploratory test, no episode.py, no commitment to 3 to 6 | Agreed. The four candidates are below. Needs Anton's pick and go. |
| 3 | E2: hold until real metrics exist | Agreed. Not built. |
| 4 | Keep the reader, buyer, trigger positioning provisionally | Agreed. Stays as written. |
| 5 | Do not redraft existing posts to fill metadata | Agreed, never planned. |
| 6 | Bogner walkthrough as separate sales priority | Agreed. Needs Anton's go and paid or free. |

One note for the go: the current rules gate asks every personal post for at least 500 characters and two quoted signals. A three-sentence caption fails that gate by design. OpenSpec task 1.4 (caption rule for pillar engagement) must be done together with the import, about an hour, no model call. It is not done yet.

## 4. What happens on the go

1. Anton names one letter per episode (E or F, C or D) and says go.
2. rules_check gets the caption rule for pillar engagement (task 1.4); the two chosen texts go through it.
3. Both are imported as drafts to the next Monday and the Friday after, with the PNG as the picture. They appear on the board as every other draft and are posted only after Anton's approval there.
4. Wednesday photo post and Thursday company post stay as they are.
5. After both episodes: a qualitative reading against the two Wednesday posts of the same weeks, written for Anton. No automatic continue or stop.

Texts are drafts: "Luftfahrt-Backend", "drei Teams" and "2016" are Anton's facts from the CV and positioning; he may change any word on the board.
